Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Responsible for designing and delivering hybrid AI Platform
  • Ensure AI platform delivery and services meet security and risk requirements and operational SLA

Business

  • Awareness how AI Platform works for the bank

Processes

  • Responsible for developing new feature for AI Platform, ensure high availability of the platform

People & Talent

  • Experience for designing, managing and maintaining Cloud and On-Premises Platform
  • Experience on working with implementing AI Platform on physical servers e.g. Dell, HP etc.

  • Deep Understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts.

You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.

  • Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
  • Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
  • Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
  • Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
  • Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
  • Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
  • By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
  • By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.

Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.

  • By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
  • By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
  • By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
  • To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.

Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.

  • By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
  • By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.
  • By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.
  • Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved.
  • Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
  • Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers

Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team

Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers

Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)

Good team player

Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products

Good verbal and written communication skills

Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services

Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants

Good level of financial analysis ability

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO

Principal Responsibilities

  • Act as the key technical enabler for the China-based team to manage and evolve CDMS-related services.
  • Drive technology decisions that improve customer journey and overall user experience.
  • Understand, clarify, and refine business/functional requirements; produce detailed technical designs for development teams.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications and services for customer journey initiatives.
  • Lead architecture and solution design with a strong focus on Java/Spring Boot/Spring Cloud best practices.
  • Perform code reviews and enforce high coding standards, secure coding principles, and engineering quality gates.
  • Promote and implement suitable design patterns to improve code flexibility, maintainability, and reuse.
  • Lead and coach developers (especially junior/new team members) to achieve delivery goals and engineering metrics.
  • Ensure robust production support and service management model, including collaboration with 3rd-party providers where needed.
  • Manage incident/problem resolution within agreed SLAs and drive root-cause fixes/preventive actions.
  • Partner with DevOps teams to improve CI/CD, release reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Support China delivery capability uplift through knowledge sharing, standards, and technical mentoring.
  • Support and participate in department management and strategic technology initiatives.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled engineering and business solutions (e.g., intelligent automation, recommendation/assistant capabilities, AI service integration) where relevant to improve efficiency and customer outcomes.
  • Continuously benchmark system performance and lead optimization initiatives across application, database, and integration layers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong track record as a Senior Java Developer / Tech Lead.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring, J2EE, and SQL technologies; passionate about adopting new technologies.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and solid object-oriented analysis/design/programming fundamentals.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Spring Boot and good knowledge of Spring Cloud and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with RESTful API design/development; practical knowledge of API technologies such as REST and WebSocket.
  • Good knowledge and hands-on experience with relational databases and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Good understanding of event-driven architecture and brokers such as Kafka.
  • Familiarity with software design patterns and clean architecture practices.
  • Experience in containerization and orchestration, ideally Docker + Kubernetes.
  • Working experience in DevOps/Agile delivery environments is a plus.
  • Practical experience with Git, Jenkins, Sonar (or equivalent CI/CD and code quality tooling).
  • Strong ability to understand business requirements in written English and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Good knowledge of benchmarking, profiling, and performance optimization.
  • Exposure to or hands-on experience in AI-related development/integration (e.g., LLM/API integration, intelligent workflow automation, AI-assisted features) is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, ownership mindset, and ability to lead under delivery pressure.

/NA

Individuals in Cross Disciplinary Controls are responsible for multiple activities within the Controls capabilities such as assessment & design, MCA, QA, Monitoring & Testing, Issue Management and/or Governance Reporting & Analysis for effective end to end oversight, design, implementation, and execution of controls. Individuals in this role may cover a broad range of in-business/function risk and control responsibilities rather than focusing on one specific role.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the assessment the effectiveness of existing controls, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing necessary changes.
  • Help drive and manage controls enhancements focused on increasing efficiency and reducing risk.
  • Assist in the execution of Enterprise Risk Management Framework and adherence with Risk Management and Compliance Policies.
  • Help support the oversight the MCA program, including the annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly attestation, quality oversight, and related reporting.
  • Assist in the execution of the MCA in accordance with the ORM Policy & Framework, as well as applicable Policies, Standards, and Procedures.
  • Help assess activities and processes as per required Policies, Standards and Procedures to strengthen risk management quality.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop comprehensive corrective action plans to address identified control gaps or failures
  • Participate in issue quality reviews ensuring compliance with
  • Issue Management Policy, Standards and Procedures
  • Support development of standardized risk and controls reporting to ensure sound, reliable, and consistent information exists across the organization, enabling better management and decision-making in line with the expectations of senior management, Board, and Regulators.
  • Participate in the oversight of the operations of Citi's governance committees, including coordinating meetings, managing agendas, and ensuring follow-up on action items.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of teams and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards

Recommended Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 6-10 years of experience in operational risk management, compliance, audit, or other control-related functions in the financial services industry.
  • Ability to identify, measure, and manage key risks and controls.
  • Strong knowledge in the development and execution for controls.
  • Proven experience in control related functions in the financial industry.
  • Proven experience in implementing sustainable solutions and improving processes.
  • Understanding of compliance laws, rules, regulations, and best practices.
  • Understanding of Citi’s Policies, Standards, and Procedures.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex risk and control activities and processes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to engage at the senior management level.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

Education:

Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred

Full time

Analytical Thinking, Assessment, Business Acumen, Constructive Debate, Controls Lifecycle, Governance, Issue Management, Process Design, Risk Management Lifecycle, Stakeholder Management.

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

  • Design APIs and ensure they are secure, scalable, and well-documented according to standards

  • Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement the necessary security controls tailored to the specific delivery or process. Identify Applicable Security controls by engaging with Security Champs

  • Ensure compliance with bank compliance guidelines & standards (e.g., data protection), address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle
  • Perform solution sizing, design detailed technological solutions for platforms, applications, or collections of applications
  • Collaborate with IT Change and Release Managers to develop strategic delivery and release plans with technical dependencies.
  • Proactively identify cross-hive or squad dependencies and risks, and develop mitigation plans to address them without waiting for formal planning sessions.
  • Develop change implementation, release plans, and run books with technical dependencies, aligning all partners with support from the squad and architect.
  • Regularly reviews squad metrics on Predictability, Quality, Squad Sentiment and supports the team to better value delivery.
  • Work with chapters to promote quality engineering, technical craftsmanship and drive solution standardization and service reusability.
  • Develop and drive application strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Subdomain Tech Lead.

  • Execute the Hive’s product vision with the Chief Product Owner.
  • Communicate technical feasibility and constraints, articulate clear explanation of technical issues to stakeholders
  • Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives
  • Influence prioritization for technology backlog and strategic initiatives.
  • Incorporate considerations of technical debt into the roadmap alongside customer outcomes, ensuring a balanced approach to long-term sustainability.
  • Align detailed technical solutions with strategic roadmaps, long-term architecture and product/platform vision and with overall organization's technology direction and standards

  • Identify and address technical and design dependencies to enhance the speed and quality of delivery, ensuring smooth delivery.

  • Responsible to work in partnership with technology to ensure a balance of functional and non-functional requirements are represented in the backlog and that there is an approach to mitigate or avoid technical debt.
  • Lead the squad in defining both functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring critical aspects like API response times and overall system performance are met.
  • Act as an expert for resolving technical and design issues.
  • Drive an accountable and sensible technical direction to build reusable, scalable and interoperable solutions that integrate with existing investments.
  • Collaborate with vendors to integrate vendor deliverables with internal systems and resolve any issues impacting delivery.
  • Drive POC or RFP and vendor evaluation exercise along with PO to ensure SCB technical standards are evaluated.
  • Create and manage the E2E Implementation architecture with very strong knowledge in AI Chatbot & VoiceBot solutions architecture, customization, configuration, integration, coding, design patterns and custom business logic
  • Engagement during requirements gathering
  • Design review of AI Chatbot & VoiceBot solutions including integrations
  • Guidance of best practices for AI Chatbot & VoiceBot solutions implementations
  • Identify potential project risks and issues
  • Support anchoring of overall technical solution while cascading the same to project delivery teams
  • Creating the optimum technical solution in the context of the customer's environment, requirements, and financial resources.

Job Summary

  • Support to act as the key liaison with external regulators, providing updates, responding to queries, and representing the company in regulatory discussions and inspections.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, work closely with legal, finance, risk, and IT departments to ensure consistency and completeness of data used in regulatory submissions and to address any compliance-related issues.
  • Support to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of reporting systems and tools to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processes through automation

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle regulatory (NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, the Bureau of Finance, the Bureau of Statistics etc.) returns preparation and submission, ensures that all regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted on time, as well as regulatory reporting instruction changes interpretation and implementation.
  • Support line manager to maintain robust quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all regulatory submissions, and reporting issues escalated through agreed governance channels.
  • Support PPG and China CA review and system upgrade project including end to end accounting flow review, upgrade the reporting logic, UAT support, regulatory reporting impact analysis to ensure compliance, accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain good relationships with relevant internal departments, assist the line manager in coordinating with the finance department and other internal functional departments for discussions, such as establishing reporting procedures for new reporting requirements, and promptly and properly resolving related regulatory reporting issues.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Support line manager to drive process and system optimisation improvements in processes, reporting, data quality through reporting automation while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Solid knowledge of banking accounting and regulatory reporting rules
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end regulatory reporting process
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities

Other Skills

  • High attention to detail and strict regulatory risk awareness
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Strong accountability and ability to work under high pressure

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, very stringent regulatory environment casts great pressure on regulatory reporting including tight local reporting deadline, continuous changing reporting requirements, energized by the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of regulatory reporting, motivated by the challenge of meeting tight deadlines under pressure while maintaining accuracy and compliance.
  • Motivated by the opportunity to streamline regulatory reporting processes, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency, driven by outcomes such as improved reporting accuracy, more efficient reporting process, reduced compliance risks etc.
  • Performs best in environments that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth, motivated by working with cross-functional teams build a strong, capable regulatory reporting function.
  • Continuous learning and adaptability required, motivated by the need to stay current with regulatory changes, emerging technologies, and industry best practices, enjoy learning and applying new automation tools and methodologies to improve reporting systems and outcomes.
  • Driven by a commitment to ethical standards and accountability, motivated by the responsibility to uphold the organization’s reputation and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & ACCA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Ensure that there is adequate support (people, processes, tools, frameworks, systems) in the respective team for necessary FCC controls.

Business

  • Support relevant stakeholders to make decisions based on current and possible future policies, practices, and trends.

Processes

  • Manage and / or resolve alerts / cases.
  • Follow the Correspondent Banking DOI to process risk events in line with Assess, Analyse, Act (AAA) process.
  • Do further analysis and escalations using knowledge about complex products.
  • Implement / roll-out Group and FCC processes / DOIs.
  • Maintain and recommend (for approval by the relevant Risk Committee), appropriate processes / DOIs to address financial crime risks, aligning with relevant regulatory requirements.

People & Talent

  • Good understanding of Financial Crime Compliance Operations; and
  • Talent with AML experiences.

Risk Management

  • Make recommendations (and / or implement) to relevant stakeholders on possible risk management responses to identified risks and / or findings of concerns from investigations.
  • Inform senior management and relevant regulators of serious regulatory breaches (or where risk tolerances have been breached) and ensure that actions are taken quickly to remediate and / or activities are ceased.
  • Analyse significant financial crime risk events (e.g.non-compliant transactions, production orders) to ensure that all connected parties, particularly cross-border are identified and reported at the appropriate levels internally across all relevant jurisdictions.
  • Apply Group and FCC policies and processes (AML surveillance, client screening, risk assessment) to manage risks.

Governance

  • Track significant issues arising from FCC metrics, FCC Assurance activities, Audit reviews and regulatory inspections, providing validation of issue closure where necessary.
  • Propose control improvements, enhancements and simplifications where appropriate.
  • Support all control checks undertaken by FCC under the Operational Risk Framework (ORF).
  • Periodic reporting and timely escalation of significant risks and issues arising from FCC Monitoring and Assurance activities.
  • Be accountable for identification and escalation of potential risks and issues to senior management through appropriate governance channels and the Quality Assurance framework.
  • Ensure tracking and remediation of surveillance and investigations related regulatory findings.
  • In the event of serious regulatory breaches, or where risk tolerances have been breached, ensure senior management are informed and that actions are taken quickly to remediate and / or activities are ceased.
  • Prepare and cascade lessons learned from audit findings, FCC assurance activities and specific investigations.
  • Collate, analyse and interpret data in reports to senior management and relevant governance / risk committees.
  • Analyse and interpret data to produce reports that help the bank identify and manage emerging areas of risk / vulnerability and thus drive remediation action within the FCC function.

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

  • Compliance Policies and Standards
  • Compliance Advisory
  • Compliance Review and FCC Assurance
  • Surveillance (including Screening and Monitoring)
  • Investigations

Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.
  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
